findings.one_line: The proof establishes only pointwise asymptotic linearity at P; equation (5) is an influence-function identity, not regularity under every local DQM path, so the claimed semiparametric-efficiency equivalence needs a fixed-strata LAN/local-alternative argument (or must be weakened to a pointwise variance comparison).

cited_checks.note: The supplied attested Newey (1990) Theorem 2.1 excerpt gives the regular-estimator convolution form Y+U, with Y normal and U independent; Sections 2--3 supply the tangent-space projection/efficiency-bound invocation used here.
